name: Elise de Lucia
source:
Half-deer, half-sister of Princess Emil.
Infantile to her core, the eldest sister of the royal family that tends to act like the youngest. Has no claim to the throne as she lacks a blood relation to the queen. Has a very troubled relationship with Emil, to say the least.

Sign: Sagittarius.
Favourite Food: Paella.
Hobbies: Cosplay.
Likes: Attention and praise.
Dislikes: Neglect.

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
